# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v4 c3 P10](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev.  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>; Reverend  <sub>[v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jonas  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>; Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an exceptionally ugly young man with a large, loose-jointed figure and absurdly long legs. He has lank, tow-colored hair, green eyes, a big mouth, and large ears. Despite his plain look, he appears radiant when happy.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

He is friendly, humorous, and exudes niceness, often laughing and joking. He is decisive and able to make up his mind quickly. Deeply dedicated to his spiritual calling, he prioritizes his duties, such as leading prayer meetings in the slums, over social engagements.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c26 P6](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0006), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)_

## Traits

- decisive  <sub>[v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)</sub>
- humorous  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>

- delivering moving wedding prayers  <sub>[v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>

## Goals

- to do the work given to him by God as a minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake was a theological student from St. Columbia who took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church for a summer. During this time, he became good chums with Philippa Gordon, spending time fishing, boating, and walking with her. Although he resisted becoming a minister for a long time, he ultimately embraced the calling. He frequently visited Patty's Place while taking early and late trains from St. Columbia, becoming popular among the residents. After proposing to Philippa Gordon, he met her parents at Mount Holly and gained their affection despite her mother's initial opposition. The two were married the following June. Years later, he attended Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe's wedding with Philippa, delivering a beautiful wedding prayer during the ceremony.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_

- came from St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>

## Quotes

> No, I couldn’t. I tried to be something else for a long time—I didn’t want to be a minister. But I came to see at last that it was the work given me to do—and God helping me, I shall try to do it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
